description: Sets the colour the next cable you patch will be given, from a list of up to seven colours; only one of these can be used in a patch

params.text: Lit, every new cable takes the colour now chosen instead of the choice stepping on to the next colour in the list

notes: clicking a colour button chooses that colour for the next new cable, and the lit button shows which colour is due to be used
with the mouse over the module, keys 1 to 9 choose the colour in that slot and L turns the lock on and off
the hotkey settings are held in a global settings file rather than in the patch, so sharing a patch does not change them
only the first Cable Palette in a patch works; a second one is drawn with no buttons and does nothing
menu: Hotkeys — leads to Global, which makes the keys work wherever the mouse is, and to the key and modifier choice for each colour and for the lock
Pick — on a colour button's own right-click menu, gives that button one of Rack's standard cable colours
Custom — on a colour button's own right-click menu, gives red, green and blue sliders, with Apply to keep the result and Cancel to drop it
Random — on a colour button's own right-click menu, gives that button a random colour
Add — on the first unused colour button's own right-click menu, puts another colour in the list
Remove — on a colour button's own right-click menu, takes that colour out of the list; it is offered only while more than one colour is left
